command.description: Fallback agent command when the agent addons supply none.

open.description: Overview terminal of a fresh worktree; when omitted it runs `bakers ui --ticket {identifier}` titled `{identifier} · {title}`, `{}` opens none. Templates expand {identifier}, {branch}, {title}, {worktree_path}.

root.description: Main clone path; derived from Git's common directory when omitted.

default.description: Agent terminal settings for every run; a `states` entry beats it.

states.description: Agent terminal settings per workflow state.

launch_watch.description: Launch-watch windows: how long a start may take and how soon an agent exit counts as a failed launch.

timeout_ms.description: Window after start in which an immediate agent exit fails the launch; 0 skips it.

start_timeout_ms.description: How long the launch waits for the wrapper to report the start.

adopt_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Orca to adopt a new worktree.

worktree_dir.description: Directory for new worktrees, relative to `root` or absolute.

base_branch.description: Base ref for new branches; when omitted, the remote-tracking branch of the checked-out branch.

auto_setup_merge.description: `false` sets Git's `branch.autoSetupMerge=false` in the root repository, so run branches have no upstream and push with `push.default=current` (see workspace-git); `true` leaves Git alone.

tab_label.description: Agent terminal title; must contain {identifier}, also expands {state}, {title}, {title_slug}, {run_uuid}, {workspace_path}. ` #<run id>` is always appended.

state.description: Agent terminal settings of a run.
